{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Identify QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
qa_mask = df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99
qa_orders = df[qa_mask]

# Define the population: loyal customers, completed status, and NOT QA orders
population = (df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & 
              (df['status'] == 'completed') & 
              (~qa_mask)

# Filter to population
loyal_completed_clean = df[population]

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = loyal_completed_clean['revenue_clean'].mean()

print(f"Number of loyal, completed, non-QA orders: {len(loyal_completed_clean)}")
print(f"Mean revenue of completed orders from loyal customers (excluding QA): {mean_revenue:.2f}")"}
